assigned_partner_consumed.use: Finite convex-mixture total-variation approximation of arbitrary cap-one product laws by compact finite-fragment indicator products; used to localize an arbitrary simultaneous supremum over output maps and affine parameters before any parameter is selected.

required_claude_source_consumed.equation_use: D/D' volume-sampling estimate applied to the simultaneous affine extremal envelope: for Z=e3(M^T M), row marginals alpha_i<=h<3/4, the full supremum over cap-one product laws and affine terms is bounded by 6 sqrt(e)(2h)^(-1/2)(3-4h)^(-1) Z^(-1/6), and equals the finite-fragment extreme supremum.

compatible_newer_result_applied.use: If M=M0+E, s3(M0)>=a, range leverage<=1/2 and ||E||op<=a/16, then the same simultaneous affine envelope is <=24 sqrt(3)e/(5a)<23/a while retaining the actual perturbed block.

new_results.statement: For an arbitrary family of measurable outputs P_theta and convex TV-lower-semicontinuous output functionals Phi_theta, the supremum over all cap-one product laws of sup_theta Phi_theta((P_theta)#mu) equals the supremum over compact finite-fragment indicator-product laws. No common parameter maximizer, support radius, fragment-count bound, separation bound or moment is required.

Because sup_{t,h>0} eta([t,t+h])/h is exactly the extended L-infinity density norm, the full supremum over arbitrary affine coefficients, target intervals, and cap-one product laws for x^T B x+ell^T x+c equals the corresponding compact finite-fragment extreme supremum.

For symmetric B, the worst-law density constant C_B(ell) depends only on the projection of ell to Ker(B); all Range(B) affine terms are removed by translating the admissible product-law class. Invertible cores therefore pay no conditioning-generated affine translation tax.

For Q(U,V)=U^TBU+2U^TCV+b^TU+F(V), with K=Ker(B), if C_B(k)<=H(k), then ||p_Q||inf^ext <= E H(P_K b+2 P_K C V). The only genuine affine conditioning obstruction is kernel leakage; if P_K C=0 it costs exactly zero.
